description: Trains supprimés par mois - Afgeschafte treinen per maand - Monthly accounts of cancelled trains is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Monthly account and proportion of cancelled trains A train can be cancelled either on a portion or on the entirety of its path. Until September 2022, the proportion of cancelled trains was calculated as the ratio between the monthly account of cancelled trains and the number of train sightings over the same period. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-03-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
